
CLEAR-VIRTUAL-HOOKS
Clear all virtual hooks from a work unit

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command when a work unit reaches "done" status and you want to remove all virtual hooks. Clears the entire virtualHooks array and cleans up all generated script files in spec/hooks/.virtual/. Useful for cleanup after story completion or when resetting work unit configuration.

PREREQUISITES
  • Work unit must exist

USAGE
  fspec clear-virtual-hooks <workUnitId>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID to clear hooks from (e.g., AUTH-001)

OPTIONS
  No options available

COMMON PATTERNS
  • Cleanup After Story Completion
    Example: fspec update-work-unit-status AUTH-001 done
# AI asks: "Keep or remove hooks?"
# User chooses: "remove"
fspec clear-virtual-hooks AUTH-001
    Standard workflow when completing a work unit and removing temporary quality checks.

  • Reset Work Unit Configuration
    Example: fspec clear-virtual-hooks AUTH-001
# Start fresh with new hooks:
fspec add-virtual-hook AUTH-001 post-implementing "<quality-check-commands>" --blocking
    Clear all existing hooks to start with a clean slate and add new configuration.

  • Bulk Cleanup After Release
    Example: fspec list-work-units --status=done
# For each done work unit:
fspec clear-virtual-hooks AUTH-001
fspec clear-virtual-hooks AUTH-002
    Clean up virtual hooks from multiple completed work units after a release.


TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  Work unit reaches done → AI asks "Keep or remove hooks?" → User chooses remove → fspec clear-virtual-hooks

EXAMPLES
  1. Clear all virtual hooks from AUTH-001
  $ fspec clear-virtual-hooks AUTH-001
  ✓ Cleared 3 virtual hook(s) from AUTH-001

  2. Clear hooks from work unit with no hooks
  $ fspec clear-virtual-hooks BUG-042
  ✓ Cleared 0 virtual hook(s) from BUG-042

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Work unit 'AUTH-001' does not exist
    Fix: Check work unit ID spelling. List all work units: fspec list-work-units

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-virtual-hook
  fspec list-virtual-hooks
  fspec remove-virtual-hook
  fspec update-work-unit-status

NOTES
  • Clears ALL virtual hooks - operation cannot be undone
  • Automatically cleans up all script files in spec/hooks/.virtual/
  • Sets virtualHooks array to empty [] (not undefined)
  • Operation is safe even if work unit has no hooks (clears 0 hooks)
  • AI prompts for this decision when work unit transitions to "done" status
  • Consider using remove-virtual-hook to selectively remove specific hooks
